note: Swiper formatter provides a 'swiper_formatter' config entity ('Swiper template', config_prefix swiper_formatter, stored as swiper_formatter.swiper_formatter.<id>) holding a big swiper_options map, plus 8 field formatters (swiper_formatter_image/entity/paragraphs/text and *_dialog variants) and a Views style (id swiper_formatter). Templates are managed at /admin/config/content/swiper-formatter; a 'default' template ships and seeds new ones via preCreate(). Rendering is delegated to the swiper_formatter.base service (Swiper::renderSwiper()). Permission: administer swiper_formatter. Hook: hook_swiper_formatter_settings_alter(). Depends on token. Medium/hard cases are grounded in real config: introspection reads a live Swiper template's swiper_options and a field view-display's formatter; execution creates a Swiper template config entity and switches a field's view-display formatter to swiper_formatter_text, both verified against live config.

evals.prompt: Using the swiper_formatter module, which field formatter turns a multi-value image field into a Swiper slider, and what is the equivalent formatter that opens each slide in a modal dialog? Name at least one other formatter the module provides.
evals.expected_output: Use the 'swiper_formatter_image' formatter for an image field; 'swiper_formatter_image_dialog' opens slides in a modal. The module also ships swiper_formatter_entity, swiper_formatter_paragraphs, swiper_formatter_text and *_dialog variants.

evals.prompt: In the swiper_formatter module, where do you create and manage the reusable Swiper option sets ("templates"), what kind of Drupal entity are they, and what is the machine id of the one that ships with the module?
evals.expected_output: They are 'swiper_formatter' config (configuration) entities managed at /admin/config/content/swiper-formatter (route entity.swiper_formatter.collection). A 'default' template ships and seeds new templates via preCreate().

evals.prompt: I want to display the results of a View as a Swiper slider with swiper_formatter. What Views 'Format' (style plugin) do I choose, and what is its plugin id?
evals.expected_output: Choose the 'Swiper formatter' Views style (plugin id 'swiper_formatter') under Format; pick a Swiper template and optionally a caption field.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has a Swiper template (swiper_formatter config entity) with the id 'sf_known'. Inspect its live configuration and state which swiping direction it is configured for.
evals.expected_output: swiper_formatter.swiper_formatter.sf_known has swiper_options.direction = 'vertical' (and autoplay enabled with a 7000ms delay).

evals.prompt: On this site the Article content type has a field named field_sf_txt that is displayed as a Swiper slider in its default view display. Inspect the live display configuration and name the exact field formatter plugin id used for field_sf_txt.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_sf_txt component has type 'swiper_formatter_text' (with the sf_known Swiper template).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, use the swiper_formatter module to create a new Swiper template (swiper_formatter config entity) with the machine id 'sf_task'. Configure it to swipe vertically and to autoplay (autoplay enabled). Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A swiper_formatter.swiper_formatter.sf_task config entity exists with swiper_options.direction = 'vertical' and swiper_options.autoplay.enabled = true (e.g. SwiperFormatter::create(['id'=>'sf_task', ...])->save()).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has a multi-value text field field_sf_txt whose default display currently uses the plain text formatter. Using the swiper_formatter module, change field_sf_txt's formatter in the default view display so it renders as a Swiper slider (the swiper_formatter_text formatter). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_sf_txt component's type is 'swiper_formatter_text'.
